answer: Problem: Sybil fleets recycle burned labels while keeping the same upstream relay fingerprint. Mechanism: joiner locks a relic stake of 5.4 POA in a ridge escrow keyed by H(pubkey||relay_fp||epoch_seed), then opens 3 orchard slots countersigned by peers from distinct /24 ASNs inside 80 minutes before weight unlocks. Cost: 5.4 POA bond for 2 epochs plus 0.11 POA fee. Verify: relic stake txid, ridge escrow id, and orchard countersigns on-ledger. Failure: shared relay_fp or ASN overlap burns 38% of the bond and quarantines that key family 3 epochs.
